title: Release day leaves every role's permissions as they were
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 1 browser · access to the test environment before the Part Lifecycle build is deployed (Setup steps 1 to 3) · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], Admin role; [User-B], a staff login you hold that has the custom role [Role-P] (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PERMS).
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: [Role-P] created before the deployment with, under Catalog and Inventory, View and Create & Edit ticked and Delete unticked; [Ticks-Before] = a screenshot or written list of every permission ticked in [Role-P] before the deployment.

Setup

  1. Before the deployment, on the earlier build, sign in as [User-A]: Settings → Roles & Permissions → Create custom role → Skip → Role name (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PERMS) → Parts Department on, Catalog and Inventory View and Create & Edit ticked, Delete unticked → Create. [Role-P] = this role.
  2. Still before the deployment, open [Role-P] in the editor and take a screenshot of every card (or write down every ticked permission). [Ticks-Before] = that record.
  3. Still before the deployment, Settings → Staff → open a staff member whose login you hold (not [User-A]) → Edit Staff Member → write down their role ([Old-Role], to put back after the test) → Role = [Role-P] → save. [User-B] = this staff member. Sign in as [User-B] and note that Parts → Inventory opens and an inventory part dialog shows no Delete button.
  4. If steps 1 to 3 could not be done before the deployment, this case cannot be run: write "no pre-deployment record, not checked" in the result comment.
  5. Check the setup worked: [Ticks-Before] exists and [User-B] has [Role-P].
custom_steps:
1. After the deployment, sign in on the Part Lifecycle build as [User-A].
  2. In the left menu open Settings, then Roles & Permissions.
  3. Click the edit (pencil) button of [Role-P].
  4. Compare every card with [Ticks-Before].
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Sign in as [User-B].
  7. Open Parts → Inventory.
  8. Click any part row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: Exactly the same permissions are ticked as in [Ticks-Before]; under the renamed group "Part Library and Inventory", View and Create & Edit are ticked and Delete is not. No permission was added, removed or moved.
  • Step 7: [User-B] can open the Inventory list, as before the deployment.
  • Step 8: The part dialog opens for [User-B] without a Delete Part button, as before the deployment (no Delete permission).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S12-N1, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas (no board shows this screen). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-N1: “No permission is added, removed or re-keyed. Every user's access on release day is identical to the day before.”
